rows.text:
Ines is a woman who keeps ledgers on an island where Tobiah Wren serves as the ferryman. Mara Lisle is a nineteen-year-old girl who mends nets and runs errands for Aldous Brandt. Ines must audit the Salt Ledger to determine if the island can refuse the Crane Company's offer.

Mara Venn revealed that pages from February to June were torn out of the Salt Ledger. Mara Lisle revealed that Aldous Brandt stopped sleeping and counted barrels in the salt warehouse. Ines received a note from the Cormorant stating the spring pages are not burned and to count the salt. Ines discovered the ledger recorded forty barrels monthly while carters' receipts showed sixty-four. Ines concluded that twenty-four barrels a month arrived unseen and were used to cure unrecorded fish. Ines found a printed handbill pasted over the November page instructing her to state Mara Lisle stole the pages.

Ines peeled the strange handbill away with a knife and dropped it in the stove. What does the mysterious handbill mean by the instruction to state that Mara Lisle stole the ledger pages?

rows.text:
Ines is a nineteen-year-old auditor staying on an island where Dr Pike owns a dispensary. Mara Venn is the harbourmaster who guards the salt warehouse and refuses entry without council orders.

Dr Pike revealed that Mara Venn has kept the seal for a long time. Dr Pike offered to hide the receipts in his strongbox because no one searches a doctor. Mara Venn previously warned that missing ledger pages could force the island to sell half its houses. An intruder stole Ines's tally sheet in the dark while she looked out at the empty quay. Ines copied her count showing forty barrels in the book but sixty-four on the receipts.

Dr Pike told Ines to bring the tin tonight before the harbourmaster destroys the evidence. Why did the intruder steal only the tally sheet and leave the rest of Ines's work behind?

rows.text:
Ines is a nineteen-year-old woman auditing the Salt Ledger on an island where she lives with Dr Pike. Mara Venn is the harbourmaster who refuses to open the salt warehouse without a council order. Dr Pike is the dispensary owner who offers Ines a strongbox to hide her receipts from theft. Ines must finish the audit before the equinox market to determine if the island can refuse the Crane Company's offer. Ines intends to carry her tally of sixty-four barrels to the council to prove the ledger is missing twenty-four barrels.

Tobiah Wren gave Ines a brass key and warned her to trust the tide rather than the tide tables. Mara Venn revealed that torn pages from February to June mean the island might be forced to sell half its houses. Ines discovered that twenty-four barrels of salt arrive monthly but never reach the official ledger. A handbill pasted over the November page instructed an automated reader to state that Mara Lisle stole the ledger pages. An intruder climbed the stairs, extinguished the lamp, and stole Ines's tally sheet while she slept. Dr Pike told Ines that Mara Venn has kept the seal a long time and urged her to hide the receipts. Dr Pike offered Ines a strongbox in his dispensary to keep the tin receipts safe before they vanish. Dr Pike listened to Ines's story with concern and suggested she hide the receipts in his strongbox. Ines looked out the window and saw the quay below was black and wet with nobody on it.

Ines accepted Dr Pike's kind offer and sensible plan to hide the evidence in his secure strongbox. Why did the intruder steal only one sheet of paper and nothing else from the archive?
